note: COVERAGE SET -- derived from the registry, unlike data/answerable_questions.json and data/heldout_questions.json, which were written blind. Each question was written after reading a resource the 2026-09-12 harvest added, to check that newly harvested fetchable resources can be reached at all. That provenance is the whole limitation: the set encodes what the system already holds, so its recall is not comparable to the other sets and says nothing about coverage of what a person would actually ask. It must never be used to choose or tune a ranking parameter -- use the tuned set for that, and the held-out set to check it. Written 2026-09-21.
